# seed 68. A host resize defers what each pane is to be told, zoom then sets the
# focused pane's rectangle directly, and the tick drains the deferred entry over
# the zoomed rectangle: the pane shrinks back to its tile with the rest of the
# region blank, and the guest is told a size it never had.
resize 60 20
layout 1
resize 60 20
zoom
tick
